title: 第9章：末日里，人和丧尸的区别会越来越小
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

凌晨两点。

仓库里一片死寂，只有妞妞睡熟后轻微的呼吸声。

林昊睡在驾驶座上，睡得不沉。

一阵尖锐的电子声音，直接在他脑子里炸开。

【检测到多个人类信号接近，距离800米，速度中等，数量6人】

这不是丧尸。

林昊睁开眼，没有丝毫犹豫，翻身下床，一脚踹在赵铁柱的铺位边上。

赵铁柱几乎是弹起来的，落地无声，右手已经摸到了靠在床边的防暴叉。

“有人。”林昊只说了两个字。

他回到驾驶座，手指在半空中划了几下。

四块分屏画面弹了出来——LV2新增的外部环境监控，夜视模式。

工业园区的入口方向，六个热成像的人影正在鬼鬼祟祟地靠近。

为首的那个光头，哪怕在夜视仪的绿色画面里，林昊也一眼认了出来。

是那个刀哥。

白天皮卡车的那伙人。

人数从四个变成了六个，队伍最后面那两人手里，各扛着一根长条状的物体。

是猎枪......

“他们果然追过来了。”

林昊的声音压得很低，“带了两杆喷子。”

赵铁柱凑过来看了一眼屏幕，脸上没什么表情。

“有枪，不能硬碰。

地方是我们的，我们地形熟，那我们就和他们玩玩捉迷藏。”

他指了指屏幕上厂房之间的狭窄巷道和散落的叉车、废料堆。

“把他们引进来，分割开，一个一个收拾。”

林昊点头。

“我去布置。”

他叫醒了其他人。

“苏晴，带妞妞和李小雨进房车，锁死门。

不管外面发生什么都别出来。”

LV2的合金装甲，猎枪的鹿弹打在上面最多留个白点。

“周建国，你待在驾驶室，手放在钥匙上，随时准备启动车。”

“陈明，你爬到仓库二楼的办公室，从窗户往外看。

我让你亮灯，你就用手电晃一下，别多晃。”

安排完，林昊从车里翻出几个空午餐肉罐头和一卷铁丝。

赵铁柱已经提着防暴叉，消失在仓库外的黑暗里。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Two o'clock in the morning.

There was deathly silence in the warehouse, except for the sound of Niu Niu's slight breathing after she fell asleep.

Lin Hao was sleeping soundly in the driver's seat.

A sharp electronic sound exploded directly in his mind.

[Detected multiple human signals approaching, distance 800 meters, medium speed, number 6 people]

This is not a zombie.

Lin Hao opened his eyes, without any hesitation, got out of bed and kicked Zhao Tiezhu's bunk.

Zhao Tiezhu almost bounced up and landed silently. His right hand had already touched the anti-riot fork leaning against the bed.

"There is someone." Lin Hao only said two words.

He returned to the driver's seat and moved his fingers in mid-air a few times.

Four split-screen images popped up - LV2's new external environment monitoring and night vision mode.

In the direction of the entrance of the industrial park, six figures with thermal imaging were approaching furtively.

Lin Hao recognized the bald leader at a glance even in the green screen of the night vision device.

It's that knife guy.

The gang in the pickup truck during the day.

The number of people increased from four to six, and the two people at the end of the team each carried a long object in their hands.

It's a shotgun...

"They really came after me."

Lin Hao's voice was very low, "I brought two trolls."

Zhao Tiezhu came over and glanced at the screen, his face expressionless.

“If you have a gun, you can’t touch it head-on.

The place belongs to us and we are familiar with the terrain, so we will play hide and seek with them."

He pointed at the narrow lanes between the factories on the screen and the scattered forklifts and scrap piles.

"Bring them in, separate them, and collect them one by one."

Lin Hao nodded.

"I'll go arrange it."

He woke the others.

"Su Qing, take Niu Niu and Li Xiaoyu into the RV and lock the door.

No matter what happens outside, don't come out."

LV2 alloy armor, the deer bullets from the shotgun will leave at most a white spot on it.

"Zhou Jianguo, stay in the cab, put your hand on the key, and be ready to start the car at any time."

"Chen Ming, climb to the office on the second floor of the warehouse and look out the window.

If I ask you to turn on the light, just use the flashlight to shake it, but don't shake it too much."

After making arrangements, Lin Hao dug out several empty lunch meat cans and a roll of wire from the car.

Zhao Tiezhu had already picked up the anti-riot fork and disappeared into the darkness outside the warehouse.
